summary: Users import Cetus BTEN-pair positions (or create them). Block10/BTEN operators rebalance for net-cheaper inventory and route depth. Protocol takes 2% of realized profits only.

fee.definition: Profit = USD value withdrawn or compounded above the user's imported cost basis for that position. No fee on principal. Fee is taken in the profit asset(s) at harvest/rebalance settle.
fee.recipient: BTEN protocol treasury / BTEN LP support per distribution_destinations.json

userFlow.import: Wallet-sign transfer or share of an eligible Cetus BTEN-pair position NFT / position object into the managed programme.
userFlow.create: Optional: open a new in-range or adjacent BTEN pair position and enroll it.
userFlow.rebalance: Operator/daemon may withdraw OOR, swap with min-out guards, and redeposit in-range using the same safety rules as bten_lp_rebalance_daemon.mjs.
userFlow.withdraw: User can exit; accrued 2% fee is settled on realized profit before return of remainder.

operator.rebalancer: laptop/bten_lp_rebalance_daemon.mjs pattern extended to enrolled user positions
operator.gas: SUI gas only from operator budget; never spend user SUI principal for inventory

onChainStatus: policy-first; Move vault escrow/fee settlement ships with v17 programme objects when enrolled positions require trust-minimised custody
